title: Onboarding Concierge: microcopy, progressive tips, and visual variants for first-run tour
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Produce a cohesive set of UI assets and microcopy variants for the console first-run experience (the ‘Onboarding Concierge’) that cover: 1) initial checklist flow, 2) empty state screens for models/dedicated/private, 3) contextual tip popovers and progressive hints, and 4) responsive/screen-reader friendly screenshot mockups for docs and release notes. Acceptance criteria: a) Figma file with frames for desktop/tablet/mobile hint overlays, b) 6 microcopy variants (default + 5 tone/length combinations) for each CTA and tip, c) 8 annotated screenshots (dark/light) exported at 2x and 3x, d) localization-ready string file (EN/FR/DE/JA) with length notes, e) accessibility checklist and keyboard-only walkthrough documented.
updates: 2026-02-20: Ticket created — initial scope and deliverables defined.
2026-02-25: Wireframes reviewed with PM and Eng. Agreed to split empty states into three contextual variants (Hosted, Dedicated, Private).
2026-03-01: Microcopy A/B samples added to Figma. Noted truncation risk for Japanese localizations; reduced headline length to 38 chars for mobile.
2026-03-05: Accessibility review (Aria/keyboard paths) with security/infra. Decided to include focus trap examples for modal tour steps.

2026-03-09: Design critique — chosen CTA phrasing: primary 'Create first endpoint' (short) and secondary 'Explore example project' (guiding). PM requested softer tone for new accounts; created 'concierge' voice variant.
2026-03-12: Exported dark/light 2x screenshots for review, added asset naming convention, uploaded sample to Drive. Preparing final PR for component export.
Pending: Add localized strings for DE/FR/JA and verify string length in UI snapshots.
design_decisions: Use a single spotlight overlay with adjustable halo radius rather than multiple bordered boxes to reduce visual noise.
Checklist should persist in console header as a collapsible pill until all steps complete — this avoids modal fatigue.
Tips will be progressive: show primary tip for first 3 visits, then switch to lighter inline hints on subsequent sessions.
Use 48px minimum tap target, with 16px minimum clear space around interactive elements for compliance with touch accessibility.
Microcopy: favor action-first CTAs (verb + object) for clarity; provide 2 tone variants (concise/concierge) for PM testing.
next_steps: Finalize localized strings and upload CSV for engineering integration.
Create component-level export PR that includes screenshot fixtures (ENG dependency).
Coordinate with engineering to add a tour toggle flag for private deployments (dependency on ENG-45123).
Run a short usability A/B with 12 internal participants comparing Concierge vs Neutral tone.
Document keyboard-only walkthrough and include in accessibility checklist page on Confluence.
notes_for_engineering: Provide a props shim for screenshot mode: --screenshot-mode=dark/light and --scale=2/3 to match exported assets.
Expose tour state (shownCount, dismissed) in console telemetry so we can A/B and measure completion rates.
Ensure localization fallback for long strings: use ellipsis + tooltip with full copy in all languages.
review_feedback: PM Marisol Vega: prefer 'Explore example project' over 'Try demo' for clarity.
Engineering lead Tomas Eriksson: prefers SVG overlays to rasterized masks; confirmed runtime performance OK.
Accessibility reviewer Leila Ahmed: requested ARIA-describedby on checklist items and alt text for all screenshots.
